title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 9: the word against the cities of the north and the coast, the King riding on a donkey, and the prisoners of hope.

questions.text: Upon which city will Yahweh's word rest, in the opening revelation?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus.

questions.text: Why are Tyre and Sidon named in the second verse?
questions.explanation: Hamath is named, which borders on it, and Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.
Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.

questions.text: What does the text say will happen to Tyre?
questions.explanation: The Lord will dispossess her and strike her power in the sea, and she will be devoured with fire.

answers.text: She will be carried to Shinar
She will bring her gold to Zion
She will be devoured with fire

questions.text: Which city will see it and fear, according to the fifth verse?
questions.explanation: Ashkelon will see it and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony, as will Ekron, and the king will perish from Gaza.

questions.text: How does the King come to the daughter of Zion?
questions.explanation: Her King comes to her righteous and having salvation, lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

answers.text: At the head of an army
With the trumpet of the Lord

questions.text: What will be cut off from Ephraim and from Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow will be cut off.

answers.text: The vine and the fig tree

questions.text: What does he declare to the prisoners of hope who turn to the stronghold?
questions.explanation: He says, "Even today I declare that I will restore double to you."

answers.text: That he will build them a house
That he will give them a new name
That he will send them a shepherd
That he will restore double to them

questions.text: What will the Lord Yahweh blow, as he goes with whirlwinds of the south?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will be seen over them, his arrow will go flash like lightning, and the Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet.

questions.text: What will make the young men flourish, in the last verse?
questions.explanation: The chapter ends by saying grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
